pokedexEntries.rb: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.

pokedexEntries.ye: Always practices its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn’t.

pokedexEntries.go: A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisible objects as it matures.

pokedexEntries.si: Its fingertips emit a peculiar force field that hardens air to create an actual wall.

pokedexEntries.cr: It uses the mysterious power it has in its fingers to solidify air into an invisible wall.

pokedexEntries.rs: MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. Its gestures and motions convince watchers that something unseeable actually exists. Once it is believed, it will exist as if it were a real thing.

pokedexEntries.fr: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

pokedexEntries.lg: If interrupted while it is miming, it will suddenly DOUBLESLAP the offender with its broad hands.

pokedexEntries.em: A MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.

pokedexEntries.di: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.

pokedexEntries.prl: Emanations from its fingertips solidify the air into invisible walls that repel even harsh attacks.

pokedexEntries.pt: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

pokedexEntries.oras: Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. Its gestures and motions convince watchers that something unseeable actually exists. Once the watchers are convinced, the unseeable thing exists as if it were real.

pokedexEntries.us: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

pokedexEntries.um: It creates invisible walls with its pantomiming. If you don’t act impressed, it will attack you with a double slap!

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Always practices its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn’t.

pokedexEntries.sw: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

pokedexEntries.sh: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

pokedexEntries.bd: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.

pokedexEntries.shp: Emanations from its fingertips solidify the air into invisible walls that repel even harsh attacks.

pokedexEntries.la: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

pokedexEntries.za: It uses the mysterious power that emanates from its fingers to solidify the air around it into invisible walls.
